description: Set the order a workflow runs its steps in, as one linear sequence. Pass every step id: a list that leaves a step out is refused, since that step would be disconnected from the run (remove it with remove_workflow_step instead). This rewires the whole automation, so a branch built on the canvas (a condition with both a True and a False path) does not survive it; use connect_workflow_steps to rebuild a fork.

step_ids.description: Every step id in the workflow (from get_workflow `steps`), each exactly once, in the order they should run.

workflow_id.description: Automation (workflow) UUID, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: reorder_workflow_steps

step_ids.description: The step ids in their new run order.

title: Reorder workflow steps
